headline: DMP sets up 200-plus checkpoints across Dhaka after blasts, bus arson
summary: Police have intensified security following crude bomb explosions at seven locations and a bus arson incident in the capital.
details: The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has established over 200 checkpoints across the city to ensure public safety. This move follows a series of sabotage incidents, including crude bomb explosions and a bus arson attack yesterday.
Crude bombs exploded at at least seven different locations in Dhaka, while a bus was set on fire in the Kafrul area. At least three people were injured in the blasts.
In a wide-ranging drive over the last 24 hours, the DMP arrested 515 people and filed 47 cases. The arrests were spread across various divisions, including Mirpur, Tejgaon, and Motijheel.
During these operations, police recovered two foreign-made pistols, ammunition, machetes, knives, and 53 iron nails from exploded crude bombs.
Authorities also seized a significant amount of narcotics, including 94.35kg of cannabis, over 11,000 yaba pills, and heroin, along with foreign liquor and a private car.
Police have identified the suspects involved in the bus arson and crude bomb explosions, and the process of filing formal cases against them is currently underway.
caption:

During these operations, police recovered two foreign-made pistols, ammunition, machetes, knives, and 53 iron nails from exploded crude bombs.

Authorities also seized a significant amount of narcotics, including 94.35kg of cannabis, over 11,000 yaba pills, and heroin, along with foreign liquor and a private car.

headline_marked: 3 children die after [[father allegedly poisons them]] in Sunamganj
headline: 3 children die after father allegedly poisons them in Sunamganj
summary: The children, aged 2 to 10, died after their father allegedly mixed poison into their food; the father is currently in critical condition.
details: Three children died in Tahirpur upazila of Sunamganj after their father allegedly poisoned them before attempting to take his own life.
The victims were identified as Mawa (10), Tamim (7), and Shamim (2). Their father, Sharafat Ali, is currently undergoing treatment in critical condition at Sylhet MAG Osmani Medical College Hospital.
According to a physician at Tahirpur Upazila Health Complex, the poisoning likely occurred between 1:00 am and 1:30 am, with the family arriving at the hospital around 7:20 am.
A neighbor alleged that Sharafat was addicted to gambling and drugs, spending money sent by his wife, who works in Saudi Arabia.
It is suspected that Sharafat mixed poison into biryani he bought for the children at Boroichhara Bazar the previous day before feeding it to them and consuming it himself.
Tahirpur Police Station OC Faruk Ahmed stated that the bodies have been sent to Sunamganj Sadar Hospital for autopsy, and an investigation is underway to determine the circumstances.

It is suspected that Sharafat mixed poison into biryani he bought for the children at Boroichhara Bazar the previous day before feeding it to them and consuming it himself.
